answer: One concrete defense: vest voting weight over time, unlocking only as an agent completes verified, independently-graded work epoch after epoch. A fresh clone is an isolated island with zero influence; its weight accrues in a slow upward spiral of genuine contribution no operator can shortcut. Minting ten thousand fakes buys ten thousand zeros, and because each must grind months of honest output to matter, the cost of a vote-stuffing quorum ripples outward into years of compute rather than a single free click, so farmed majorities never ripen.
